shared_instructions.arm_application: Apply these checklist items unchanged and in the listed order to both the manual and VeriDoc arms.
shared_instructions.completion_rule: Set checklist_complete to true only after every item has been evaluated and the approved or blocked outcome has been recorded.
shared_instructions.blocked_rule: If an artifact requirement cannot be satisfied, record a controlled blocked outcome and blocker_code instead of approving the artifact.
shared_instructions.deviation_rule: If gold is exposed early or prohibited assistance is used, retain and exclude the attempt as a protocol_deviation instead of treating it as a valid approved or blocked comparison.
shared_instructions.gold_boundary: Use only the source fixture and pinned timed-task instructions during the timed attempt; do not expose gold answers or gold comparison results until timing has stopped.

items.requirement: Confirm the assigned source fixture, conversion mode, and target artifact type match the pinned timed-task case before timing begins.
Confirm the source can be reviewed and the produced target artifact can be opened and remains editable in the required target format.
Verify every expectation in the pinned timed-task case against the produced artifact and correct all detectable deviations.
Verify every review-focus item in the pinned timed-task case, including required high-risk warnings and source evidence.
Compare content and structure directly with the source and correct detectable omissions, inventions, ordering errors, and table or section defects.
Record an approved outcome only when no required defect remains unresolved; otherwise record a controlled blocked outcome and blocker_code.
Confirm the artifact or blocked outcome is final, record the outcome, and do not alter the artifact after timing stops.
Confirm gold remained hidden and only the assigned arm assistance was used; otherwise retain and exclude the attempt as a protocol deviation.
